item.title: A guide to Team USA in Olympic ice hockey
item.description: The Winter Olympics are in full swing in Milan, and Team USA is making every preparation to dominate on the ice. The 2026 Winter Olympics is the first time women's professional hockey players have ever represented Team USA due to the establishment of the Professional Women's Hockey League in North America in 2023.
